title: Finite-module Kummer cohomology of the two geometric lines
statement: Let Ω be algebraically closed, A a finite commutative ring, ell a prime invertible in Ω, N≥1 and ell^N A=0. On X=A1_Ω and U=D(t), let F=mu_(ell^N) tensor A, with the canonical coefficient map. For any invertibility witness hm, H1(U,F) is A-linearly isomorphic to A, carrying the actual Kummer class of t to 1. Hq(X,F)=0 for q>0, Hq(U,F)=0 for q≥2, and actual derived degree-zero restriction is an isomorphism. No freeness of A over Z/ell^N is assumed.

source.place: Steps 1--3; unit proof paragraphs Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1; Milne Sections 14 and 16.

proof.text: The low-degree Kummer calculation gives the normalized H1 isomorphism on the punctured line, H1=0 on the affine line, while the connected constant-sheaf calculation gives actual degree-zero restriction. For q≥2 apply finite_line_high_cohomology to the given coefficient sheaf, with n=ell^N>0. Split q>0 into q=1 and q≥2 to obtain all positive affine-line vanishings.

theorem finite_line_cohomology (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ℓ N : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓΩ : IsUnit (ℓ : Ω)) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hA : ((ℓ ^ N : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    (hm : IsUnit ((ℓ ^ N : ℕ) : Γ(Line (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)), ⊤))) :
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)
    let X := Line S
    let F := Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A (ℓ ^ N) X hA 1
    let H := ((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (openObject S)).rightDerived 1).obj F
    ∃ e : H ≅ ModuleCat.of A A,
      e.hom (kummerClass A X (openObject S) F (ℓ ^ N) hm
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteRootMap A (ℓ ^ N) hA X) (coordinateUnit S)) = 1 ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A
        (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, 2 ≤ q → IsZero (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology A
        (openObject S)).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
      IsIso ((NatTrans.rightDerived
        (F := sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))
        (G := sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (openObject S))
        ((sheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).map
          (restriction S).op) 0).app F)
